title: Color in nature
creator_credit: Konstantin Grigoriev and Encyclopaedia Britannica Films
brief_description: Explores the function of coloration in both plants and animals using nature footage and close-up photography. Examines how color can benefit living organisms in their environment; shows how pigments can cause different colors; identifies the pigment chlorophyll as an essential element in the process of photosynthesis. Suitable for upper primary and secondary levels.
